rationale: The test discriminates between two isolated mechanisms. Its observed response favors lock contention within Q but supplies no exclusion test for co-occurring or unlisted mechanisms, licensing the stated limitation.

signal_basis.exact_text: The specified differential is lock contention versus connection-pool exhaustion.
The capacity increase leaves Q latency unchanged while Q lock waits remain elevated.
The validated predictions give a decrease for isolated pool exhaustion and no decrease for isolated lock contention.
